target_audience: High-net-worth investors, venture partners, project leaders, corporate executives

spacing_rules.section_divider: relative my-8 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-amber-500/20 to-transparent

hero_section.mobile_hierarchy: 1. Eyebrow badge -> 2. High-impact serif headline -> 3. Gold subtle gradient subtitle -> 4. Dual CTA action row -> 5. Floating key stats pill
hero_section.vertical_rhythm: pt-24 pb-12 flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-4

card_grid_system.card_style: glass-card rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between border border-amber-500/15 relative overflow-hidden active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
card_grid_system.image_wrapper: relative aspect-[16/10] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg mb-2.5 bg-slate-900/60
card_grid_system.image_style: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-105
card_grid_system.badge_style: absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-medium bg-slate-950/80 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm
card_grid_system.title_style: text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 line-clamp-2 leading-snug mb-1.5
card_grid_system.meta_row: mt-auto pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-amber-400/90

mobile_tab_bar.container_style: bg-[#060B18]/92 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-amber-500/20 px-2 py-1.5 flex justify-around items-center shadow-2xl pb-safe
mobile_tab_bar.item_style: flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[10px] py-1 px-3 rounded-lg text-slate-400 transition-colors active:text-amber-400

chat_widget.style: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 text-slate-950 p-3 rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 active:scale-95 transition-transform border border-amber-300/40

page_blueprints.home: Hero section with radial glow + 2x2 Service Cards + 2-Column Project Card Grid + Stat Counter Bar + Partner Marquee
page_blueprints.projects: Category Filter Horizontal Scrollable Pill Bar (no-scrollbar) + 2-Column Dual Card Grid with status badges & tags + Search Bar
page_blueprints.cooperation: 4-Step Vertical Connected Process Path + Captain Income System 3 Tiers Cards + 3 Business Model Glass Cards
page_blueprints.about: Key Milestones Vertical Timeline + Data Wall 2x2 Grid + Core Team 2-Column Cards
page_blueprints.contact: Mobile Form with 16px font inputs (prevents iOS auto-zoom) + Direct One-Touch Phone/WeChat Call Action Buttons

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, forms, navigation tabs, project cards, filter pills, and floating triggers MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all mobile cards fit within a strict 2-column grid (`grid-cols-2`) on screens <= 767px without text overlap or clipped borders.
Apply `Noto Serif SC` to section titles using `font-display` utility class and `text-gold-gradient` for high-end luxury feel.
Keep all form inputs at minimum `16px` font size on mobile to prevent automatic iOS zoom on focus.
Maintain strict `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive components.
Use Lenis scroll instance with lightweight CSS transitions for touch interactions to keep mobile FPS smooth at 60fps.
